src/content/crush-flank.js.source: 压开侧翼 · 碾压候选
前方仓库无法撞穿。西边维修道的低木栅可以用履带顶住压断：保持前进，只有车身真正碰到的栅栏段才会倒下，留下可驶过的碎木。压开西侧缺口可以绕到炮塔侧面；也可走东边较快但暴露的柏油路。此候选只实现分段低栅栏碾压，高杆和房屋坍塌尚未实现。
src/content/crush-flank.js.target: The warehouse cannot be rammed through. Drive into the low timber fence on the west maintenance lane and keep pressing forward: only the segments touched by the hull collapse, leaving traversable debris. Open a west-side gap to flank the gun, or take the faster exposed east road. This candidate implements low fence crushing only; tall poles and building collapse are not yet implemented.

src/terrain-candidate/combat-mission.js.source: 坡地侧翼 · 战斗整合候选
原坦克与战斗系统的坡地整合候选：炮口、瞄准与弹丸共用坡面坐标，山坡可挡住射线。碾开低木栅，从侧翼攻击炮位后驶入北侧出口。建筑底座为平整地基。采用保守倾斜包围盒，无逐轮悬挂；当前未完成实机验收。
src/terrain-candidate/combat-mission.js.target: An isolated hillside integration of the original tank and combat systems. Muzzle, aiming and shells share the terrain surface; hills block shots. Crush the low fence, flank the gun and reach the north exit. Buildings stand on level foundations. Tilted collision uses conservative bounds, without individual suspension. Device testing is pending.

src/terrain-candidate/ridge-convoy.js.source: 堤路护送 · 山脊与双线
把补给车带到北部接应区，而不是清空所有炮位。驶入东侧金圈选硬路：路短，但会暴露在炮位前；驶入西侧金圈选低地土路：路长，中央山脊能挡弹，入口木栅须用履带压开。选路后锁定。可点“车队待命”或按 H 把车留在掩体后，绕侧清炮后再按“继续护送”；待命时敌火不会暂停。补给车会等待你靠近，也会停在未清障碍或你的车身后。可先清炮位，再回车队，也可边走边护送。山脊后的北炮位需绕侧才能击中，正面装甲会挡弹。
src/terrain-candidate/ridge-convoy.js.target: Escort the supply truck to the northern rendezvous; you do not have to destroy every gun. Enter the eastern gold circle for a shorter exposed paved road, or the western circle for a longer sheltered dirt route. Crush the west gate with your hull. Selection locks the truck route. Stay nearby; the truck waits when blocked or when you are too far away. Clear threats first or fight on the move. Flank the northern gun beyond the ridge; its frontal armor blocks shots. After choosing a route, use Hold convoy or H to wait behind cover; clear the flank and order Advance convoy. Enemy fire continues while held.

src/scorched-front.js.source: 焦土货运站 · 穿越封锁
src/scorched-front.js.target: Scorched Freight Yard · Break the Blockade

src/scorched-front.js.source: 护送补给车穿过废弃货运站，到达北侧接应区。东侧硬路短，但装甲巡逻车封锁路口；西侧泥路较长，中央山脊可遮挡炮火。东路外沿的混凝土断墙是真实掩体，不能碾碎；西侧木栅仍可履带压开。按 H 或点车队待命，先侦察再让车队前进。远处烟柱只是环境，不会挡住敌人的视线。无需消灭所有敌人，别把敌车残骸堵在车队路线上。
src/scorched-front.js.target: Escort the supply truck through the abandoned freight yard to the northern rendezvous. The shorter eastern road is guarded by an armoured patrol; the longer western track uses the ridge as cover. Concrete wall remnants are solid cover, not crushable. Wooden western barriers can be crushed. Press H or use Hold convoy to scout before advancing. Distant smoke is cosmetic and does not block enemy sight. You need not destroy every enemy; keep wrecks off the convoy route.

src/crossfire-front.js.source: 焦土交叉火线 · 协同护送
护送补给车穿过焦土货运站，到达北侧接应区。蓝方支援车在西路外侧牵制敌方侧翼车，双方会真实交火；支援车不是护送目标，损失它不会直接失败。东侧硬路短但有敌车封锁，西侧绕行可借山脊掩护。按 H 或点车队待命，先侦察再推进。友军会挡住炮弹：不要朝补给车或支援车开火，也不要挡在友军炮口前。无需消灭所有敌人，别让敌车残骸堵住车队路线。
src/crossfire-front.js.target: Escort the supply truck through the scorched freight yard to the northern rendezvous. The blue support tank west of the road engages an enemy flanker with real fire; it is not an escort objective, and losing it does not immediately fail the mission. The eastern road is shorter but guarded; the western route uses the ridge as cover. Press H or Hold convoy to scout before advancing. Friendly vehicles stop shells: do not fire at the truck or support tank, and keep clear of friendly muzzles. You need not destroy every enemy. Keep wrecks off the convoy route.

src/crossfire-v3-front.js.source: 焦土交叉火线 V3 · 前沿接应
护送补给车到达北侧接应区。开局左前方的蓝方支援车与敌方侧翼车会真实交火；两车在路外固定阵位，支援车不是护送目标，损失它不会直接失败。东侧硬路短但有敌车封锁，西侧绕行可借山脊掩护。按 H 或点车队待命，先侦察再推进。友军会挡住炮弹：不要朝补给车或支援车开火，也不要挡在友军炮口前。无需消灭所有敌人，别让敌车残骸堵住车队路线。
src/crossfire-v3-front.js.target: Escort the supply truck to the northern rendezvous. The blue support tank ahead-left and an enemy flanker exchange real fire from fixed positions off the routes. Support is not the escort objective; losing it does not directly fail the mission. The eastern hard road is short but guarded; the western detour uses the ridge for cover. Press H or order the convoy to hold while scouting. Allied hulls block shells: do not fire at supply or support vehicles, or stand in front of their guns. You need not destroy every enemy. Keep wrecks out of the convoy lane.

src/crossfire-v4-front.js.source: 焦土交叉火线 V4 · 机动接应
护送补给车到达北侧接应区。开局前方的蓝方支援车与敌方侧翼车会真实交火；两车会在装填间歇沿短路线机动，瞄准蓄力时停车，遇到障碍也会停下。支援车不是护送目标，损失它不会直接失败。东侧硬路短但有敌车封锁，西侧绕行可借山脊掩护。按 H 或点车队待命，先侦察再推进。友军会挡住炮弹：不要朝补给车或支援车开火，也不要挡在友军炮口前。无需消灭所有敌人，别让敌车残骸堵住车队路线。
src/crossfire-v4-front.js.target: Escort the supply truck to the northern rendezvous. At the start, the blue support tank and enemy flanker exchange real fire ahead. Both reposition along short patrols while reloading, stop to charge their shots, and stop if blocked. The support tank is not an escort objective; losing it does not directly fail the mission. The eastern hard road is shorter but guarded; the western detour offers ridge cover. Press H or select Hold convoy to scout before advancing. Friendly vehicles block shells: do not fire at the supply truck or support tank, and keep clear of friendly muzzles. You need not destroy every enemy. Avoid leaving enemy wrecks on the convoy route.

src/recovery-direction.js.source: 停稳→看接触→试前进或倒车，留侧隙转炮；勿强挤
src/recovery-direction.js.target: Stop → check contact → try forward/reverse; leave space and turn gun away. Do not force.
